status: SEED -- the estimator that consumes this ships in milestone M4.
methodologyNote: Deliberately the simplest defensible model. A single-scenario expected-loss figure that an executive can interrogate beats a composite score they cannot. Both inputs are assumptions supplied by the consultant, not measurements, and the report states that plainly.

defaults.impactBasis: Estimated total cost of a single successful business email compromise or ransomware event, including downtime, recovery, legal and notification.
